data.name: Letalis
data.detailed_description:
Meet the Letalis, fearless warriors forged for the arena, where every battle is fought for “Glory or Death".
As the Manager, you must lead your fighters to greatness and claim the title of Caesar. Explore a world filled with secrets, challenges and forgotten legends.


Features
• Recruit over 1,000 unique Letalis.
• Catch and Fuse Letalis to create powerful new variants.
• Explore an immense non-linear world.
• Conquer challenging Coliseums and defeat powerful Caesars.
• Discover hidden dungeons and secrets.
• Uncover rare recruits and legendary treasures throughout your journey.
• Inspired by classic Monster-Collecting and Turn-Based RPGs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E8400 or AMD Phenom II x2 550
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 260 or Radeon HD 4850
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-750 or AMD Phenom II x4 945
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650 or Radeon HD 5770
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
